name: bdk-native
description: Turn a live web app built with Lovable, Bolt, Replit, Base44, Bubble or any other tool into signed iOS and Android apps for the App Store and Google Play with BDK Native: a phone preview first, then project setup, checkout and build requests through BDK's hosted MCP server, with your approval at every paid or store-facing step.

interface.shortDescription: Web app to iOS and Android
interface.longDescription: Turn a web app you already run into signed iOS and Android apps. Preview it on your own phone, create and set up a BDK project, open checkout on Stripe's hosted page, and request builds. Your assistant asks for your approval before every purchase, build request, terms acceptance and change to installed apps. You sign in to your BDK account in your browser; keys and passwords stay on the BDK portal, never in chat. You test and submit the apps from your own Apple and Google accounts.
capabilities: Preview your web app on your own phone
Create and set up a BDK project
Check what your project needs next
Open checkout and request builds with your approval
Download your delivered Android and iOS builds
defaultPrompt: Put my web app on my phone as an app preview.
Where is my BDK project and what is the next step?
